subject.title: [Bug][iOS] chat.history reconciliation duplicates and reorders replies after tool runs

question: Is the detailed 2026.7.1 Gateway trace sufficient to sponsor a targeted native-chat repair, or must the delayed-history sequence first be captured or replayed on current main?
rationale: The observable failure is credible and release-current, but the repository does not yet contain evidence identifying which history request or projection transition corrupts state on current main.

options.title: Require deterministic replay first
options.body: Reproduce concurrent delayed history completion through the real shared view model, then implement the smallest reconciliation fix demonstrated by that fixture.

options.title: Sponsor repair from trace
options.body: Accept the supplied release trace as sufficient and directly implement generation gating plus stable-identity reconciliation with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Require deterministic replay first
recommendation.body: Reproduce concurrent delayed history completion through the real shared view model, then implement the smallest reconciliation fix demonstrated by that fixture.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and routed the immediately adjacent shared-native reconciliation fix and are best positioned to judge whether the supplied trace is sufficient.
